title: Trucker Watching TikTok Kills 5 People in Horrifying Crash
description:
Bodycams show the moments surrounding a deadly crash in Chandler, Arizona, that was caused by the driver of a tractor-trailer who prosecutors said was distracted by TikTok. Danny Glen Tiner, 38, was taken into custody after an FBI analysis of his phone allegedly revealed that he was actively viewing content moments before the fiery six-car collision that killed five, according to authorities. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
